title: Adverbs of Frequency (Review+)
objectives: Use adverbs of frequency (review+) accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use frequency adverbs naturally in A2 discourse.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about adverbs of frequency (review+). How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use adverbs of frequency (review+)?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never — position with one/two verbs.

Questions: How often do you…?

grammar.title: Adverbs of Frequency (Review+)
grammar.rule: Always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never — position with one/two verbs.

reading.title: Adverbs of Frequency (Review+) in Context
reading.text: I usually wake up early, but I rarely have time for breakfast. How often do you exercise? — About three times a week.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using adverbs of frequency (review+). Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: I rarely eat fast food. She walks every day. I travel once a month. He hardly ever complains.
